CFML Language Reference: Functions

Cos

Returns the cosine of an angle. The angle must be in radians; to convert degrees, multiply by Pi() and divide by 180.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

Cos(number)

Parameters

number
An angle in radians.

Returns

A number between -1 and 1.

Usage

Floating-point arithmetic is not exact: Cos(Pi()/2) gives a tiny number such as 6.12E-017 rather than a clean zero. Format results with NumberFormat or Round before showing them.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Degrees</TH><TH>Cos</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="deg" LIST="0,30,45,60,90,180">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#deg#</TD><TD>#NumberFormat(Cos(deg * Pi() / 180), "9.9999")#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
